messages:
Alex: Heads up — main turned red right after merging PR #1289 (model-kernel caching change). e2e-gpu-matrix job failed on `route_inference_smoke` with kernel alloc OOM. deploy-bot posted failure at step 'start-detectors'. Can someone sleuth? @Liam @Maya :eyes:

ci-bot: buildkite › e2e-gpu-matrix-108 failed (exit 137). Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/builds/108 — error chunk: `AllocationError: cudaMalloc returned out of memory`

Liam: I'll take a look. Reproduced locally on a 16GB test node, same OOM. Quick log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:21Z] kernel_alloc.cc:47 allocate() size=1.9GB -> failed (available 1.2GB)
[2026-03-17T12:34:21Z] kv_cache.cc:202 reserve prefetched=384MB active=2.1GB
```

Maya: Noted — PR #1289 changed the KV cache eviction ordering and added speculative prefetch for small sequences. Could increase transient memory. Might be a regression in the eviction heuristic.

Sam: I can trigger a rebuild quickly: `/bk rebuild e2e-gpu-matrix-108` — doing that now.

deploy-bot: Rebuild queued: e2e-gpu-matrix-108 -> e2e-gpu-matrix-109 (requested by Sam).

Liam: Rerun (109) failed in same spot, same OOM. Running with `--kv-trace` to get allocation timeline. Early output shows large spike right after first batch.

Olivia: If the eviction heuristic is wrong, bisecting is probably fastest to find the offending commit. @Liam do you want me to run a git bisect across the merge window (start=origin/main~10, end=HEAD)? I can script runs on a small replica cluster.

Liam: Yes please, Olivia — that helps. I'll attach the `--kv-trace` logs to the bisect run. If bisect exceeds ~30m, Sam, can you open a quick hotfix to reduce the e2e smoke `batch_size` from 16->8 to keep main green?

Sam: On it. I'll open a tiny revert/hotfix PR and tag it `hotfix/ci-smoke-batch-reduce`, add tests.

Alex: Plan ack'd. Quick checklist: 1) Olivia runs bisect (scripted) 2) Liam collects KV traces + points at commit 3) Sam opens hotfix if bisect >30m or PR confirmed bad 4) Notify infra oncall if we need to revert fast.

Maya: Also posting eval notes — if eviction ordering is at fault we might see perf regressions. Liam, please note any perf diffs in the bisect output.

Liam: Will do. Starting bisect now. Sharing progress in this thread. :mag:
